expected_memories.content_gist: The RP2040 supports crystals from 1 MHz to 15 MHz
The RP2040 reference design uses a 12 MHz crystal
The PLLs can generate a 48 MHz clock meeting the USB frequency accuracy requirement and a 133 MHz maximum speed system clock
An external clock can be driven directly into XIN at up to 50 MHz with the oscillator circuit disabled
To use the XOSC clock outside the RP2040 it must be routed to a GPIO via a clk_gpout clock generator rather than taken directly from XIN or XOUT
The recommended crystal for the RP2040 is the Abracon ABM8-272-T3
The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has a centre frequency of 12.000 MHz
The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has an operating temperature range of -40 to +85 degrees Celsius
The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has a storage temperature range of -55 to +125 degrees Celsius
The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has a frequency tolerance of -30 to +30 ppm at 25 degrees Celsius
The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has an equivalent series resistance of 50 ohms and a shunt capacitance of 3.0 pF
The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has a load capacitance of 10 pF and a drive level between 10 and 200 microwatts
The crystal oscillator is powered from VDDIO, so the Abracon crystal and its damping resistor are tuned for 3.3 V operation and must be re-tuned for a different IO voltage
